results.criterion: /hr/settings/workflow exposes a real default-off workflow-policy workspace and invokes only SHARED-API-005 after exact read admission.
evidence: HrisWorkflowPolicyWorkspace does not mount ActiveWorkflow without exact cross-product admission.
hrisWorkflowPolicyDataSource.list delegates only to getApprovalPolicies with the installed owner context scope and AbortSignal.
The workspace and slice targets prove default-off zero-call and authorized list behavior.

results.criterion: Policy publish invokes only SHARED-API-006 with current policy version, governed execution and owner-confirmed outcome.
evidence: The source snapshot is re-read from the exact query cache before dispatch and must retain policy ID, version, pending-review state and independent actor.
The command runner receives the exact policy-publish route, decision revision and object version; publishApprovalPolicy preserves step-up and idempotency semantics.
No optimistic success or local command receipt is created; only the returned Approval owner projection is installed.

results.criterion: /hr/team/delegation exposes a real default-off manager workspace and invokes only SHARED-API-010 for the installed population.
evidence: Delegation admission requires APP.HCM and APP.APPROVALS, the manager plane, exact read capability/duty, an opaque owner scope and a population scope.
hrisDelegationDataSource.list delegates only to getApprovalDelegations with the installed owner context scope and AbortSignal.
The workspace test proves owner list rendering and subject-revision visibility.

results.criterion: Delegation create and revoke invoke only SHARED-API-011 and SHARED-API-012 with owner window, scope, revision and governed execution intact.
evidence: The adapter passes create input unchanged to createApprovalDelegation and passes delegation ID plus expected version unchanged to revokeApprovalDelegation.
The slice target proves create pending without optimistic success and revoke execution with objectVersion 9.
Successful commands replace the exact owner query projection and invalidate only its exact cache key.

results.criterion: Read and command capabilities are evaluated separately.
evidence: workflowReadAdmitted and workflowPublishAdmitted are separate predicates; delegationReadAdmitted and delegationManageAdmitted are separate predicates.
An admitted read with no command decision renders disabled mutation controls and makes no mutation call.
Each command predicate requires the exact action route set and decision revision.

results.criterion: Cross-product entitlement, tenant, actor, role, duty, population, purpose, revision and SoD near misses fail closed before owner access.
evidence: The common admission predicate requires both product views and exact equality of HCM tenant/actor with Approval-owner tenant/actor.
Workspace-specific predicates require exact role plane, read duty, capability, route, bound purpose and population where applicable.
Command predicates require subject revision, current decision revision and exact ordered SoD seals; the contract target covers each negative class.

results.criterion: Adapters preserve existing Approval contracts and add no proxy, business transition or second receipt.
evidence: Only approval-management-api.ts#getApprovalPolicies and approval-api.ts publish/list/create/revoke clients are called.
No axios, fetch, HRIS endpoint, backend source or persistence path exists in the changed paths.
Owner outcomes explicitly state that no local receipt was created.

results.criterion: Operational states remain explicit and do not render a blank canvas.
evidence: Source renders explicit loading, empty, owner-unavailable, permission, stale-focus, command-pending, owner-confirmed and owner-rejected states.
Policy and delegation adapters are independent, so one unavailable owner view does not erase the other workspace shell.
The slice target directly exercises loading, empty, unavailable, permission, pending and success states.

results.criterion: Tab and focus are URL-addressable and unauthorized focus values are removed without disclosure.
evidence: Only tab=overview and a bounded safe focus token are accepted by the local query-state parser.
Missing or stale focus is replaced with the first authorized owner row, or removed for an empty list.
Scope identity changes remount the active subtree and discard prior selection, command feedback and query state.

results.criterion: Both workspaces provide responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, contrast and reduced-motion-safe source behavior.
evidence: Responsive minmax grids collapse at xs and expand at md; copy uses overflowWrap and no fixed canvas width.
Interactive rows use ButtonBase with aria-current and visible focus; loading uses aria-busy and commands expose textual pending outcomes.
No custom animation or color-only status exists. Browser screenshots and viewport/theme claims are deferred because browserBeforeCentralMountAuthorized=false.

results.criterion: Feature OFF or unenrolled tenant mounts no owner runtime and exposes no enabled command.
evidence: Both exported runtime state constants are OFF.
Without exact tenant-enrolled admission the active React Query subtree is never mounted.
The slice and both workspace tests prove zero list, publish, create and revoke calls when admission is absent or invalid.

results.criterion: Changed-path and no-recount evidence proves all forbidden owner and central-control paths remain unchanged.
evidence: All 14 source paths are inside the three exact writable frontend patterns.
Shared Approval clients, generated authorization, HRIS shell model and backend controllers retain their base hashes.
No backend, migration, OpenAPI, Auth, Gateway, route catalog, product-authorization, historical register or Batch01 evidence path changed.
